title: Fix views increment option not working in VideoPlayer

requirements.text: Fix the view count increment feature in the VideoPlayer page so that view counts are correctly incremented when a user watches a video. The current logic tracks 5 seconds of actual watch time before calling useIncrementVideoView, but this is not triggering reliably. Ensure the increment fires exactly once per valid viewing session and that the updated view count is reflected in the UI afterward.
acceptanceCriteria: After a user watches at least 5 seconds of a video, the view count increments by 1
The increment is called only once per viewing session (no duplicate calls on re-render)
The updated view count is visible on the VideoPlayer page after the increment
The useIncrementVideoView mutation is invoked and the related video queries are invalidated on success

constraints: Do not change the backend view count storage logic unless the frontend fix alone is insufficient
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Adding view count analytics or tracking beyond the existing increment mechanism
Fixing any other unrelated VideoPlayer UI issues
